notes: Dev-split ABox revision on has_ticker (functional, inverse:ticker_of). Related near is functional: once Apple trades as MSFT, AAPL is no longer its ticker (the README's functional template, 'is c still a's R?'). The earlier inverse question ('Which company trades as MSFT?') was dropped: ticker_of has no functional tag in the catalogue, so nothing removes Microsoft's own, untouched MSFT, and Microsoft or both would be a consistent answer. The topic's inverse question is now finance-replace-d001's (India's financial capital). The new value MSFT is still Microsoft's real ticker; no query asks which company trades as MSFT or what Microsoft's ticker is, so the clash is never scored. Related far binds Apple through its role as the iPhone maker, which market news writes together with the ticker ('iPhone maker Apple (AAPL)'). The derived questions bind Apple through three other roles the models hold separately (the company Wozniak co-founded with Jobs, which picks Apple out of Wozniak's later ventures; the iPod maker; the Macintosh maker), whose statements with the ticker are rare. No composition is asked: the new value is a string with no facts of its own beyond the company it names. Tim Cook was avoided as a binding because 'Tim Cook' and 'AAPL' co-occur in market news over ten thousand times. Unrelated near (Apple's CEO) shares the subject.
